data.content_ref: inline:The statistical signature proposed is not discriminating. The target's own countercondition states that a hidden shared trigger occurring at a frequency/distribution mimicking a Poisson process would evade the test. But more deeply, even burstiness is ambiguous: truly independent failures can exhibit apparent clustering purely by chance in finite samples (Poisson processes produce runs), while a hidden shared cause with staggered propagation delays can produce a non-bursty, evenly spread failure pattern. Hence temporal burstiness/latency cannot reliably distinguish true independence from pseudo-uncorrelated failure.
